definitions.explanation: food that is partially cooked, leaving the inside raw or undercooked

examples.japanese: ⟦ステーキ→ステーキ：01369_suteeki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半生|はんなま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}いて→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{半生|はんなま}だ。

{半生|はんなま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Eating undercooked chicken can cause food poisoning, so please make sure it is thoroughly cooked.

notes:
Describes food that is only partially cooked. Can be desirable (as with a medium-rare steak or a soft-boiled egg) or a health concern (as with undercooked chicken). Note the reading: {半生|はんなま} refers to cooking doneness, while the same kanji read as はんせい means "half a lifetime."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半生|はんなま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: soft-boiled/half-raw egg
- {半生|はんなま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to cook medium-rare
- {半生|はんなま}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: half-cooked state

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧: raw — completely uncooked
- ⟦レア→レア：11251_rea⟧: rare — loanword used specifically for steak doneness
- ⟦{半熟|はんじゅく}→半熟：11935_hanjuku⟧: soft-boiled — specifically for eggs, where the yolk is still runny
- ⟦{生焼|なまや}け→生焼け：22421_namayake⟧: undercooked — implies the food should have been cooked more
